title.zh: 卷316 列傳一百三 瑚尔起 爱隆阿 巴灵阿 舒明 福禄 齐里克齐 阎相师 伊柱 努三 乌勒登
title.en: Volume 316 Biographies 103: Hu Er Qi, Ai Long A, Ba Linga, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qi Likeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yi Zhu, Nu San, Wu Leideng
title.raw: 卷316 列傳一百三 瑚尔起 爱隆阿 巴灵阿 舒明 福禄 齐里克齐 阎相师 伊柱 努三 乌勒登

sentences.zh: 列傳一百三 瑚爾起愛隆阿弟巴靈阿舒明福祿齊里克齊 閻相師伊柱努三烏勒登 瑚爾起，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Biographies 103: Hu Erqi, Ai Long'a, [his] younger brother Ba Ling'a, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qilikeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yizhu, Nusan, Wuleideng. Hu Erqi, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 103: Hu Erqi, Ai Long'a, his younger brother Ba Ling'a, Shu Ming, Fu Lu, Qilikeqi, Yan Xiangshi, Yizhu, Nusan, and Wuleideng. Hu Erqi, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 自筆帖式累遷協領。

translations.literal: From clerk he was promoted in succession to assistant commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from clerk through successive promotions to assistant commander.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，從征金川。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong, he accompanied the campaign against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Qianlong reign he took part in the campaign against Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 遷呼倫貝爾總管。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be commander of Hulun Buir.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as commander of Hulun Buir.

sentences.zh: 二十年，從征準噶爾，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, he joined the campaign against the Dzungars and was given the rank of vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he joined the Dzungar campaign and was granted the rank of vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，從參贊大臣達爾黨阿自珠爾都斯逐捕阿睦爾撒納，诇知阿睦爾撒納竄哈薩克，從定邊左副將軍哈達哈以師臨之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, he followed the campaign counselor Da Erdang'a from Zhuerduosi in pursuit of Amursana; learning that Amursana had fled into Kazakh territory, he marched with the Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Ha Daha to bring troops against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he followed campaign counselor Da Erdang'a from Zhuerduosi in pursuit of Amursana; when scouts reported that Amursana had fled into Kazakh lands, he marched with Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Ha Daha to bring the army up against him.

sentences.zh: 哈薩克汗阿布賚拒戰，擊敗之，斬百餘級，得馬二百餘。

translations.literal: The Kazakh khan Abulai refused battle; they defeated him, beheaded more than a hundred men, and captured more than two hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: When the Kazakh khan Abulai refused to fight, they routed him, took more than a hundred heads, and seized over two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 獲其頭人，言阿睦爾撒納方在泥雅斯圖山，檄阿布賚擒獻。

translations.literal: They captured a Kazakh leader, who said Amursana was then on Niyasitu Mountain; they sent a dispatch ordering Abulai to seize and deliver him.
translations.idiomatic: They captured a Kazakh leader who reported that Amursana was then on Niyasitu Mountain, and issued a dispatch ordering Abulai to seize him and send him in.

sentences.zh: 杜爾默特貝勒巴圖、伯羅特等潛通阿睦爾撒納，瑚爾起與戰輝巴朗山，執伯羅特，盡殲其部眾，及阿睦爾撒納所留烏梁海五十餘戶。

translations.literal: The Durbet prince Batu, Berote, and others had secretly communicated with Amursana; Hu Erqi fought them at Huibolang Mountain, seized Berote, and annihilated their entire following, as well as more than fifty Urianghai households left behind by Amursana.
translations.idiomatic: The Durbet prince Batu, Berote, and others had been in secret contact with Amursana; Hu Erqi fought them at Huibolang Mountain, captured Berote, and wiped out their entire following along with the more than fifty Urianghai households Amursana had left behind.

sentences.zh: 沙喇斯、瑪呼斯既降复叛，掠台站，而布魯古特台吉琿齊等戕察哈爾總管巴寧阿以叛。

translations.literal: Shalasi and Mahusi had submitted but rebelled again, plundering courier stations; meanwhile the Burut taiji Hunchi and others killed the Chahar commander Baning'a in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Shalasi and Mahusi had surrendered but rebelled again and raided courier stations, while the Burut taiji Hunchi and others killed Chahar commander Baning'a and rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 上命瑚爾起偕鄂實、三格副哈寧阿，將千人駐濟爾哈朗、巴里坤適中地，捕琿齊及沙喇斯、瑪呼斯部眾。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hu Erqi, together with Eshi and Sange assisting Haning'a, to lead a thousand men and garrison the midpoint between Jierhalang and Barkol to capture Hunchi and the followers of Shalasi and Mahusi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Hu Erqi, together with Eshi and Sange assisting Haning'a, to take a thousand men and garrison the midpoint between Jierhalang and Barkol to capture Hunchi and the bands of Shalasi and Mahusi.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起偕鄂實追剿扎哈沁逃賊，又偕副都統巴圖濟爾噶勒自呼斯坦至尼勒喀河，偵琿齊等百餘戶游牧，突擊，執之。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi, with Eshi, pursued and attacked fleeing Zahachin bandits; he also joined Vice Commandant Batujiergale from Hustan to the Nileka River, reconnoitered more than a hundred households of Hunchi and others at pasture, made a surprise attack, and seized them.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi joined Eshi in pursuing Zahachin fugitives, then marched with Vice Commandant Batujiergale from Hustan to the Nileka River, located more than a hundred households of Hunchi and his people at pasture, struck by surprise, and captured them.

sentences.zh: 尋從師自伊犁逐剿諸回部，至善塔斯巔，招降布魯特頭人圖魯啟拜、鄂庫及其部眾，搜捕阿里瑪圖河逸賊。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he followed the army from Ili in pursuing and suppressing the various Muslim districts, reaching Shantasi Peak; he induced the Burut leaders Turuqibai and Eku and their followers to submit, and searched out fugitive bandits along the Alimatu River.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed the army from Ili in the pursuit and suppression of the Muslim districts as far as Shantasi Peak, induced the Burut leaders Turuqibai and Eku and their people to surrender, and hunted down fugitive bandits along the Alimatu River.

sentences.zh: 上以索倫兵從征久，召瑚爾起及副都統鄂博什率以還，瑚爾起等仍請從軍。

translations.literal: Because the Solon troops had campaigned for a long time, the emperor summoned Hu Erqi and Vice Commandant Eboshi to lead them back; Hu Erqi and the others still asked to remain with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Solon troops had been on campaign so long, the emperor recalled Hu Erqi and Vice Commandant Eboshi to lead them home, but Hu Erqi and his men still asked to stay with the army.

sentences.zh: 將軍兆惠攻霍集占於葉爾羌，被圍，定邊右副將軍富德檄瑚爾起及巴圖濟爾噶勒率索倫兵自伊拉里克赴援，以馬駝未至，負糧械步行戈壁中。

translations.literal: General Zhao Hui attacked Huojizhan at Yarkand and was besieged; the Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De dispatched Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead Solon troops from Ilirik to the relief; as horses and camels had not yet arrived, they carried grain and weapons on foot across the Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: When General Zhao Hui attacked Huojizhan at Yarkand and found himself besieged, Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De ordered Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead Solon troops from Ilirik to his relief; with horses and camels not yet arrived, they shouldered grain and arms and marched on foot across the Gobi.

sentences.zh: 上獎諭，即授正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: The emperor issued commendatory edicts and immediately appointed him Mongol vice commandant of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him in edict and at once appointed him Mongol vice commandant of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 師至巴爾楚克，兆惠圍已解，與富德軍合。

translations.literal: When the army reached Barkul, Zhao Hui's siege had already been lifted, and they joined Fu De's forces.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the army reached Barkul, Zhao Hui's siege had already been lifted, and they united with Fu De's army.

sentences.zh: 霍集占之徒阿卜都克勒木等侵和闐，攻哈拉哈什，侍衛齊凌扎卜請援，兆惠令瑚爾起與巴圖濟爾噶勒督兵赴援。

translations.literal: Huojizhan's follower Abudukelimu and others invaded Khotan and attacked Karakash; bodyguard Qilingzhabu requested aid, and Zhao Hui ordered Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to lead troops to the relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huojizhan's follower Abudukelimu and others invaded Khotan and attacked Karakash; bodyguard Qilingzhabu called for help, and Zhao Hui ordered Hu Erqi and Batujiergale to take troops to their relief.

sentences.zh: 齊凌扎卜馳告，夜行至伊立齊，賊聞兵至，引退。

translations.literal: Qilingzhabu rode in haste to report; they marched by night to Yiliqi, and when the bandits heard troops had arrived, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qilingzhabu rode in haste with word of the attack; they marched by night to Yiliqi, and when the rebels heard troops were coming, they pulled back.

sentences.zh: 诇知賊騎七百餘屯博爾齊，天大霧，瑚爾起督兵突擊，賊潰走，退至皁窪勒河，斬百餘級，收回人四千餘戶，和闐遂平。

translations.literal: Scouts learned that more than seven hundred rebel horsemen were encamped at Bo'erqi; a heavy fog blanketed the sky, and Hu Erqi directed a surprise attack; the bandits broke and fled, retreating to Zaowale River; more than a hundred were beheaded, and more than four thousand households were recovered; Khotan was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts reported that more than seven hundred rebel horsemen were encamped at Bo'erqi; in a thick fog Hu Erqi led a surprise attack, the rebels broke and fled to Zaowale River, more than a hundred were killed, more than four thousand households were recovered, and Khotan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上賦博羅齊行紀事，賜瑚爾起雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: The emperor composed a narrative poem on the Bo'erqi campaign and granted Hu Erqi a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed a narrative poem on the Bo'erqi campaign and granted Hu Erqi a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 師自喀喇烏蘇逐捕霍集占，至阿爾楚爾。

translations.literal: The army pursued Huojizhan from Karasu to Altur.
translations.idiomatic: The army pursued Huojizhan from Karasu as far as Altur.

sentences.zh: 賊設伏兩山間，我軍張兩翼擊之，賊敗走三十里，負山而屯。

translations.literal: The bandits set an ambush between two mountains; our army deployed both wings to attack them; the bandits were defeated and fled thirty li, then encamped with the mountain at their backs.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels laid an ambush between two mountains; our army struck with both wings, routed them for thirty li, and they made camp with the mountain at their backs.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起等自山麓橫衝入陣，師夾擊，賊大敗，越山遁，師從之，至伊西洱庫爾淖爾。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi and others charged horizontally into the battle line from the foot of the mountain; the army attacked from both sides; the bandits were utterly defeated, fled over the mountain, and the army pursued them to Lake Yixihuku'er.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi and others charged into the line from the mountain foot while the army struck from both sides; the rebels were routed, fled over the mountains, and the army pursued them to Lake Yixihuku'er.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起等為伏東山，側擊，賊復大敗，霍集占竄入巴達克山。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi and others lay in ambush on the eastern mountain and struck from the flank; the bandits were again utterly defeated, and Huojizhan fled into Badakhshan.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi and others lay in ambush on the eastern mountain and struck from the flank; the rebels were routed again, and Huojizhan fled into Badakhshan.

sentences.zh: 巴達克山汗素勒坦沙獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: The Badakhshan khan Sultan Shah presented Huojizhan's head.
translations.idiomatic: The khan of Badakhshan, Sultan Shah, sent in Huojizhan's head.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起將索倫兵還，賚銀幣，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi led the Solon troops back; he was rewarded with silver and coins, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and he was ranked among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi led the Solon troops home, was rewarded with silver and coins, had his portrait placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and was ranked among the first fifty meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 瑚爾起疏言：「呼倫貝爾多水泉，可耕。

translations.literal: Hu Erqi memorialized: "Hulun Buir has many springs and can be cultivated.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Erqi memorialized: "Hulun Buir has abundant springs and land fit for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 請選塔里雅沁降回百戶往耕。

translations.literal: I request that a hundred households of surrendered Muslims from Taliyachin be selected to go and farm there."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that a hundred households of surrendered Taliyachin Muslims be chosen to settle and farm there."

sentences.zh: 」上命瑚爾起以副都統為呼倫貝爾總管，董其事。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Hu Erqi, with his vice commandant rank, to serve as commander of Hulun Buir and supervise the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Hu Erqi, while retaining his vice commandant rank, to serve as commander of Hulun Buir and oversee the project.

sentences.zh: 移黑龍江副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be vice commandant of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commandant of Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 從征緬甸，收猛拱、猛養諸地。

translations.literal: He joined the campaign against Burma and recovered Menggong, Mengyang, and other districts.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Burma campaign and recovered Menggong, Mengyang, and other districts.

sentences.zh: 卒於軍。

translations.literal: He died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜騎都尉，並前世職為一等輕車都尉，祀昭忠祠。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Cavalry Captain, and together with his previous hereditary office was raised to a first-class Commandant of Light Chariots; he was enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Cavalry Captain, and together with his earlier hereditary rank was raised to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots; he was enshrined in the Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 愛隆阿，覺爾察氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Ai Long'a, of the Jerci clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Long'a, of the Jerci clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒侍衛累遷齊齊哈爾副都統。

translations.literal: From vanguard guardsman he was promoted in succession to vice commandant of Qiqihar.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard guardsman through successive posts to vice commandant of Qiqihar.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，授領隊大臣，赴巴里坤軍營。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Qianlong he was appointed column commander and went to the Barkol army camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed column commander and went to the Barkol army camp.

sentences.zh: 偕參贊大臣富德逐捕巴雅爾，至愛登蘇，遇阿布賚部眾突出，數與戰，卻之。

translations.literal: Together with campaign counselor Fu De he pursued Bayar to Aidengsu; they encountered Abulai's followers making a sudden appearance, fought them several times, and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: With campaign counselor Fu De he pursued Bayar to Aidengsu, met Abulai's followers in a sudden attack, fought them several times, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 自巴爾楚克至濟爾哈朗置台站，逐賊沙喇博和什嶺，遇都爾伯特納木奇游牧，乞降，旋遁去，愛隆阿追及之，殺千餘人，納木奇遂納款。

translations.literal: From Barkul to Jierhalang they established courier stations; pursuing bandits at Shalabohuoshi Ridge, they encountered the Dorbet Namuchi at pasture, who begged to submit but soon fled; Ai Long'a overtook him, killed more than a thousand men, and Namuchi then tendered allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: They set up courier stations from Barkul to Jierhalang and pursued bandits at Shalabohuoshi Ridge; they met the Dorbet Namuchi at pasture, who begged to surrender but soon fled; Ai Long'a caught up with him, killed more than a thousand men, and Namuchi then submitted.

sentences.zh: 師至察罕烏蘇，收厄魯特宰桑烏魯木游牧百餘戶。

translations.literal: When the army reached Chahan Usu, they received more than a hundred households of the Oirat zaisang Ulumu at pasture.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Chahan Usu, they took in more than a hundred households of the Oirat zaisang Ulumu at pasture.

sentences.zh: 師屯濟爾哈朗，命愛隆阿駐守濟爾哈朗、巴里坤適中地。

translations.literal: The army encamped at Jierhalang; Ai Long'a was ordered to garrison the midpoint between Jierhalang and Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: The army encamped at Jierhalang, and Ai Long'a was ordered to garrison the midpoint between Jierhalang and Barkol.

sentences.zh: 尋從靖逆將軍雅爾哈善討霍集占。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he followed the Pacification General Ya Erhashan in campaigning against Huojizhan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Pacification General Ya Erhashan in the campaign against Huojizhan.

sentences.zh: 先是愛登甦之戰，侍衛奇徹布戰沒，至是愛隆阿上言：「前擒巴雅爾，奪還奇徹布屍，富德未及疏列。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the battle at Aidengsu, bodyguard Qichebu had been killed in action; now Ai Long'a submitted: "When Bayar was captured earlier, Qichebu's corpse was recovered, but Fu De had not yet reported it in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, at the battle of Aidengsu, bodyguard Qichebu had been killed in action; now Ai Long'a submitted: "When Bayar was captured earlier, we recovered Qichebu's body, but Fu De had not yet reported it in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 」定邊將軍兆惠疏言：「愛隆阿原報所無，事後追論，顯為爭功，請嚴議。

translations.literal: Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui memorialized: "What Ai Long'a now claims was not in his original report; raising it afterward is clearly striving for merit—please subject him to strict deliberation."
translations.idiomatic: Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui memorialized: "What Ai Long'a now claims was absent from his original report; raising it afterward is clearly an attempt to claim credit—please subject him to strict review."

sentences.zh: 」詔原之。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 師圍庫車，賊來援，愛隆阿等與戰於戈壁，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: The army besieged Kuche; bandits came to relieve it; Ai Long'a and others fought them on the Gobi and destroyed a great many of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When the army besieged Kuche and rebels came to relieve the city, Ai Long'a and others fought them on the Gobi and killed a great many.

sentences.zh: 霍集占將五千人續至，愛隆阿等率吉林及索倫兵千騎逐賊至鄂根河側，與戰，迫賊入水，死者三千餘人。

translations.literal: Huojizhan brought five thousand men in continued relief; Ai Long'a and others led a thousand Jilin and Solon horsemen in pursuit to the bank of the Egen River, fought them, drove the bandits into the water, and more than three thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan brought five thousand more men to relieve the city, Ai Long'a and others led a thousand Jilin and Solon horsemen in pursuit to the Egen River, fought them, drove them into the water, and more than three thousand drowned or were killed.

sentences.zh: 拔其纛，驛致京師。

translations.literal: They seized the enemy standard and sent it by courier post to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They captured the enemy standard and sent it by courier to the capital.

sentences.zh: 上為賦回纛行，獎其能戰。

translations.literal: The emperor composed a poem on the return of the standard and praised their fighting ability.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed a poem on the return of the standard and praised their prowess in battle.

sentences.zh: 旋從將軍兆惠至葉爾羌，與霍集占部眾戰，當左翼。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he followed General Zhao Hui to Yarkand, fought Huojizhan's followers, and held the left wing.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed General Zhao Hui to Yarkand, fought Huojizhan's followers, and held the left wing.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被困，靖逆將軍納穆札爾赴援，愛隆阿將兵截喀什噶爾賊援路。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui was besieged; Pacification General Namuzha'er went to his relief; Ai Long'a led troops to cut off the Kashgar rebel relief route.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hui was besieged, Pacification General Namuzha'er went to relieve him, and Ai Long'a led troops to cut off the Kashgar rebel relief route.

sentences.zh: 徼巡台站，至托罕塔罕，遇賊，剿殺百餘人。

translations.literal: Patrolling courier stations, he reached Tohantahan, encountered bandits, and killed more than a hundred in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: While patrolling courier stations he reached Tohantahan, met rebels, and killed more than a hundred in action.

sentences.zh: 上授愛隆阿參贊大臣，令與定邊右副將軍富德援兆惠。

translations.literal: The emperor appointed Ai Long'a campaign counselor and ordered him, together with Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De, to relieve Zhao Hui.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor appointed Ai Long'a campaign counselor and ordered him, with Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De, to relieve Zhao Hui.

sentences.zh: 愛隆阿戰呼爾璊，再戰葉爾羌河，遂與兆惠軍合。

translations.literal: Ai Long'a fought at Hu'erlan, fought again at the Yarkand River, and then joined Zhao Hui's army.
translations.idiomatic: Ai Long'a fought at Hu'erlan and again at the Yarkand River, then united with Zhao Hui's army.

sentences.zh: 尋引兵駐烏什，兼防喀什噶爾，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he led troops to garrison Ushi and also guard Kashgar; he was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led troops to garrison Ushi while also guarding Kashgar, and was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 復從富德逐霍集占，戰於伊西洱庫爾淖爾。

translations.literal: He again followed Fu De in pursuing Huojizhan and fought at Lake Yixihuku'er.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Fu De in pursuit of Huojizhan and fought at Lake Yixihuku'er.

sentences.zh: 徼巡台站，值嗎唬斯、賓巴等謀劫察罕烏蘇台站，以兵追襲，斬獲殆盡，進騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: While patrolling courier stations, he found Mahusi, Binba, and others plotting to raid the Chahan Usu station; he pursued with troops and killed or captured nearly all of them; he was advanced to a hereditary Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: While patrolling courier stations he found Mahusi, Binba, and others plotting to raid the Chahan Usu station, pursued them with troops, and killed or captured nearly all; he was advanced to a hereditary Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 師還，授正白旗護軍統領，兼鑲白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was appointed commander of the guards of the Plain White Banner and concurrently Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was appointed commander of the guards of the Plain White Banner and concurrently Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and he was ranked among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and he was ranked among the first fifty meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 再進一等輕車都尉兼一云騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was further advanced to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots with an additional hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: He was further advanced to first-class Commandant of Light Chariots with an additional hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 授伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed campaign counselor of Ili.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed campaign counselor of Ili.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 弟巴靈阿，自親軍校累遷二等侍衛，授察哈爾總管。

translations.literal: His younger brother Ba Ling'a, from imperial guards corporal was promoted in succession to second-class bodyguard and appointed Chahar commander.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Ba Ling'a rose from imperial guards corporal to second-class bodyguard and was appointed Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 賜坤都爾巴圖魯名號，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He was granted the title Kundul Baturu and appointed column commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the title Kundul Baturu and appointed column commander.

sentences.zh: 在博羅齊搜捕厄魯特部眾，遇伏戰死，賜雲騎尉世職，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: At Bo'erqi, while searching out Oirat followers, he met an ambush and died in battle; he was posthumously granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy; his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and he was ranked among the latter fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: At Bo'erqi, while hunting down Oirat followers, he was ambushed and killed in battle; he was posthumously granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, and he was ranked among the latter fifty meritorious officials.

sentences.zh: 舒明，烏梁海濟勒莫特氏，蒙古正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Shu Ming, of the Urianghai Jilemote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming, of the Urianghai Jilemote clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自二等侍衛累遷都察院左副都御史、正黃旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: From second-class bodyguard he was promoted in succession to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate and commander of the guards of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from second-class bodyguard to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate and commander of the guards of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 命赴北路軍，為諸部降人董理游牧。

translations.literal: He was ordered to the Northern Route army to supervise the pastoral arrangements of surrendered peoples from the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to the Northern Route army to oversee the pastoral settlement of surrendered peoples from the various tribes.

sentences.zh: 旋授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 诇知降人訥默庫戕台站侍衛，謀以所部叛，馳奏。

translations.literal: Learning that the surrendered man Nemuku had killed a courier-station bodyguard and planned to rebel with his following, he rode in haste to report.
translations.idiomatic: When he learned that the surrendered man Nemuku had killed a courier-station bodyguard and planned to rebel with his following, he rode in haste to report it.

sentences.zh: 敕參贊大臣阿蘭泰往捕治，阿蘭泰請益兵，上責其紛擾。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered campaign counselor Alantai to go and capture him; Alantai requested additional troops, and the emperor rebuked him for causing confusion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered campaign counselor Alantai to go and capture him; when Alantai asked for more troops, the emperor rebuked him for stirring up trouble.

sentences.zh: 訥默庫就擒，上以舒明籌策得宜，而阿蘭泰推諉遲誤，奪阿蘭泰三等男爵畀舒明。

translations.literal: Nemuku was captured; because Shu Ming's planning had been appropriate while Alantai had shirked and delayed, the emperor stripped Alantai of his third-class baronage and gave it to Shu Ming.
translations.idiomatic: When Nemuku was captured, the emperor found Shu Ming's planning sound but Alantai evasive and dilatory; he stripped Alantai of his third-class baronage and gave it to Shu Ming.

sentences.zh: 舒明在邊，諸部降人至者，為之拊循。

translations.literal: While Shu Ming was on the frontier, he comforted and guided all surrendered peoples from the various tribes who arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier Shu Ming comforted and guided all surrendered peoples from the various tribes who came in.

sentences.zh: 噶勒雜特宰桑根敦降，上授佐領，使與丹畢游牧同處。

translations.literal: The Galazat zaisang Genden submitted; the emperor appointed him assistant banner commander and had him pasture together with Danbi.
translations.idiomatic: When the Galazat zaisang Genden submitted, the emperor made him assistant banner commander and had him pasture together with Danbi.

sentences.zh: 都爾伯特台吉伯什阿噶什、烏巴什降，上授伯什阿噶什親王、烏巴什貝子，游牧額爾齊斯，舒明為陳請留屯哈達青吉勒。

translations.literal: The Dorbet taiji Boshigashi and Ubashi submitted; the emperor made Boshigashi a prince and Ubashi a beile, with pasture on the Irtysh; Shu Ming memorialized asking that they remain garrisoned at Hadaqingjile.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dorbet taiji Boshigashi and Ubashi submitted, the emperor made Boshigashi a prince and Ubashi a beile, with pasture on the Irtysh; Shu Ming memorialized asking that they remain garrisoned at Hadaqingjile.

sentences.zh: 達什達瓦部降，編為三旗，移阿爾台；

translations.literal: Dashidawa's following submitted and was organized into three banners and moved to Altai;
translations.idiomatic: When Dashidawa's following submitted, they were organized into three banners and moved to Altai;

sentences.zh: 其續至者，使處扎哈沁舊游牧地。

translations.literal: those who continued to arrive were settled on the former Zahachin pastures.
translations.idiomatic: those who continued to arrive were settled on the former Zahachin pastures.

sentences.zh: 策淩烏巴什、巴圖博羅特及達瑪林等部眾貧甚，疏請賑，上為發米六百石。

translations.literal: The followers of Tsewang Ubashi, Batubolot, and Damalin and others were extremely poor; he memorialized requesting relief, and the emperor issued six hundred piculs of grain.
translations.idiomatic: The followers of Tsewang Ubashi, Batubolot, Damalin, and others were desperately poor; he memorialized for relief, and the emperor issued six hundred piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 上聞和托輝特青滾雜卜將叛，命舒明诇之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard that the Khoshut Chinggunjab was about to rebel and ordered Shu Ming to reconnoiter.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard that the Khoshut Chinggunjab was about to rebel, he ordered Shu Ming to investigate.

sentences.zh: 舒明言叛已著，命會將軍成袞札布等捕治。

translations.literal: Shu Ming reported that the rebellion was already manifest; he was ordered to join General Chenggunjab and others in capturing and punishing him.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming reported that the rebellion was already evident; he was ordered to join General Chenggunjab and others in capturing and punishing him.

sentences.zh: 授參贊大臣，成袞札布令將科布多兵二百以往。

translations.literal: He was appointed campaign counselor; Chenggunjab ordered two hundred troops from Kobdo to go with him.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed campaign counselor, and Chenggunjab ordered two hundred Kobdo troops to accompany him.

sentences.zh: 上命侍衛巴寧阿勒泰將三百人為舒明佐。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered bodyguard Baning'altai to lead three hundred men to assist Shu Ming.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered bodyguard Baning'altai to lead three hundred men to assist Shu Ming.

sentences.zh: 旋命偕成袞札布駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was ordered to join Chenggunjab in garrisoning Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to join Chenggunjab in garrisoning Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 授理籓部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 再遷綏遠城將軍，兼領歸化城都統。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to be General of Suiyuan and concurrently commander of Guihuacheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to General of Suiyuan and concurrently commander of Guihuacheng.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he died.

sentences.zh: 子雅滿泰，襲三等男。

translations.literal: His son Yamantai inherited the third-class baronage.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yamantai inherited the third-class baronage.

sentences.zh: 累遷正白旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Mongol vice commandant of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to Mongol vice commandant of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 坐事左授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: For an offense he was demoted to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 與保泰同充駐藏大臣。

translations.literal: Together with Baotai he served as Resident Minister in Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: He served together with Baotai as Resident Minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀侵後藏，與保泰同得罪，荷校被杖。

translations.literal: When the Gurkhas invaded Rear Tibet, he and Baotai were both found guilty, placed in the cangue, and flogged.
translations.idiomatic: When the Gurkhas invaded Rear Tibet, he and Baotai were both punished, placed in the cangue, and flogged.

sentences.zh: 復起至頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: He was later restored and rose again to first-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was later restored and rose again to first-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 福祿，旺察氏，蒙古正白旗人。

translations.literal: Fu Lu, of the Wangcha clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lu, of the Wangcha clan, was a Mongol of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自護軍校累遷福建建寧鎮總兵。

translations.literal: From guards corporal he was promoted in succession to regional commander of Jianning in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from guards corporal to regional commander of Jianning in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 內移正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred within the capital to Mongol vice commandant of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred within the capital to Mongol vice commandant of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 外授直隸宣化、廣東右翼諸鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was appointed outside the capital as regional commander of Xuanhua in Zhili and of the Right Wing in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted outside the capital as regional commander of Xuanhua in Zhili and of the Right Wing in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 又內移正紅旗漢軍副都統。

translations.literal: He was again transferred within the capital to Chinese Banner vice commandant of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred within the capital to Chinese Banner vice commandant of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十三年，授參贊大臣，駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Qianlong he was appointed campaign counselor and garrisoned at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of the Qianlong reign he was appointed campaign counselor and garrisoned at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 旋命將索倫兵二千人赴巴里坤。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was ordered to lead two thousand Solon troops to Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to lead two thousand Solon troops to Barkol.

sentences.zh: 時定邊左副將軍成袞札布與參贊大臣阿桂會討舍楞，福祿請具三月糧，自科布多輸送，從之。

translations.literal: At that time Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Chenggunjab and campaign counselor Agui were jointly campaigning against Seleng; Fu Lu requested three months' provisions to be transported from Kobdo, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Chenggunjab and campaign counselor Agui were jointly campaigning against Seleng; Fu Lu asked for three months' provisions to be shipped from Kobdo, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 至海拉爾，與御前侍衛敦察會師進。

translations.literal: When they reached Hailar, they joined the imperial bodyguard Duncha and advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: At Hailar they joined the imperial bodyguard Duncha and marched forward together.

sentences.zh: 旋佐將軍兆惠討霍集占，偕定邊右副將軍富德帥師次呼爾璊。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he assisted General Zhao Hui in campaigning against Huojizhan and, together with Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De, led troops encamped at Hu'erlan.
translations.idiomatic: He soon assisted General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan and, with Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De, led the army to encamp at Hu'erlan.

sentences.zh: 霍集占以五千餘人來犯，福祿偕領隊大臣永慶率索倫、察哈爾兵擊之，自巳至申，與賊戰十餘次，賊潰去。

translations.literal: Huojizhan came to attack with more than five thousand men; Fu Lu, together with column commander Yongqing, led Solon and Chahar troops to strike them; from the si hour to the shen hour they fought the bandits more than ten times, and the bandits broke and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan attacked with more than five thousand men, Fu Lu and column commander Yongqing led Solon and Chahar troops against them; from mid-morning to mid-afternoon they fought more than ten engagements, and the rebels broke and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 進次葉爾羌河岸，城賊突圍出，富德與福祿等領中軍自右進，追賊渡河，賊屢敗。

translations.literal: Advancing to the bank of the Yarkand River, garrison bandits broke out in a sortie; Fu De and Fu Lu and others led the center army from the right, pursued the bandits across the river, and the bandits were repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to the Yarkand River, garrison rebels broke out in a sortie; Fu De and Fu Lu led the center from the right, pursued them across the river, and routed them again and again.

sentences.zh: 兆惠自葉爾羌出，至阿爾吉什，偵鄂斯璊方侵和闐，疏請富德、福祿帥師策應。

translations.literal: Zhao Hui came out from Yarkand to Arjish; scouts reported that Esijian was then invading Khotan; he memorialized requesting Fu De and Fu Lu to lead troops in support.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Hui marched out from Yarkand to Arjish; when scouts reported that Esijian was invading Khotan, he memorialized asking Fu De and Fu Lu to bring troops to support him.

sentences.zh: 上命福祿偕策布登札布以兵堵霍集占竄俄羅斯路。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Fu Lu, together with Tsebudunjab, to block with troops Huojizhan's route of flight into Russia.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Fu Lu, together with Tsebudunjab, to block Huojizhan's escape route into Russia.

sentences.zh: 旋命駐軍和闐，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was ordered to garrison Khotan and was granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered to garrison Khotan and granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 遷杭州將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be General of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾平，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the Dzungars were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: After the Dzungars were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 上巡浙江，福祿督駐防兵肄武，制閱武詩獎之。

translations.literal: When the emperor toured Zhejiang, Fu Lu supervised the garrison troops in military drill; the emperor composed an inspection poem to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: During the emperor's tour of Zhejiang, Fu Lu supervised the garrison in military drill, and the emperor composed an inspection poem to reward him.

sentences.zh: 調西安將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be General of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to General of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 以老乞休。

translations.literal: On grounds of old age he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: On grounds of old age he asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 卒 齊里克齊，蒙古鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: He died. Qilikeqi was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He died. Qilikeqi was a Mongol of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初為額魯特人，以地為氏。

translations.literal: Originally he was an Oirat; he took his territory as his clan name.
translations.idiomatic: Originally an Oirat, he took his territory as his clan name.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十年，師徵準噶爾，來降。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the Qianlong reign, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he came over and submitted.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾平，從定邊將軍兆惠擊霍集占，戰於霍爾果斯。

translations.literal: When the Dzungars were pacified, he followed Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui in attacking Huojizhan and fought at Khorgos.
translations.idiomatic: After the Dzungars were pacified, he followed Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan and fought at Khorgos.

sentences.zh: 霍集占敗走，降頭人圖魯啟拜等，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: When Huojizhan was defeated and fled, he induced the headmen Turuqibai and others to submit; he was appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan was defeated and fled, he induced the headmen Turuqibai and others to surrender and was appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 護哈薩克使臣詣京師，遷三等侍衛。

translations.literal: He escorted a Kazakh envoy to the capital and was transferred to third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He escorted a Kazakh envoy to the capital and was promoted to third-class bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 復從定邊右副將軍富德擊霍集占，至色勒庫爾，敵踞山以拒。

translations.literal: He again followed Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De in attacking Huojizhan; reaching Sarikul, the enemy held the mountains to resist.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Pacification of the Frontier Right Vice General Fu De against Huojizhan; at Sarikul the enemy held the heights and resisted.

sentences.zh: 齊里克齊偕前鋒參領喀木齊布督健銳營兵自山陰攀登仰擊，霍集占敗遁。

translations.literal: Qilikeqi, together with vanguard adjutant Khamuqibu, directed the Vanguard Camp troops to climb from the northern slope of the mountain and attack upward; Huojizhan was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Qilikeqi and vanguard adjutant Khamuqibu led the Vanguard Camp up the northern slope in an uphill attack; Huojizhan was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 降所部二千餘人，獲軍器、駝騾，賜布哈巴圖魯勇號。

translations.literal: More than two thousand of his followers submitted; military equipment and camels were captured; he was granted the courageous title Buhu Baturu.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand of his followers surrendered; arms and camels were captured; and he was granted the courageous title Buhu Baturu.

sentences.zh: 師還，命在乾清門行走，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity; his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was ordered to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 再遷頭等侍衛，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to first-class bodyguard and granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to first-class bodyguard and granted a hereditary Cloud Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，遇賊於底麻，敗之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, he followed General Mingrui in the Burma campaign; at Dima he encountered bandits and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he followed General Mingrui against Burma, met rebels at Dima, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 賜副都統銜。

translations.literal: He was granted the rank of vice commandant.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the rank of vice commandant.

sentences.zh: 召回京，再遷鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Recalled to the capital, he was again promoted to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to the capital, he was again promoted to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，師徵金川，命督健銳營從參贊大臣阿桂出南路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to supervise the Vanguard Camp in following campaign counselor Agui on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to lead the Vanguard Camp with campaign counselor Agui on the southern route.

sentences.zh: 授領隊大臣，攻美諾，克之。

translations.literal: He was appointed column commander, attacked Meinuo, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed column commander, attacked Meinuo, and took it.

sentences.zh: 金川平，師還，領健銳營。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified and the army returned, he commanded the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified and the army returned, he commanded the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，教匪起，送察哈爾馬如湖北軍，事竟即還。

translations.literal: Early in the Jiaqing reign, when the sect rebels rose, he sent Chahar horses to the Hubei army; when the affair was over he returned at once.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign, when sect rebels rose, he sent Chahar horses to the Hubei army and returned as soon as the affair was over.

sentences.zh: 上以未請從軍，詔詰責，奪官，削世職。

translations.literal: Because he had not requested to join the campaign, the emperor issued an edict of reproof, stripped him of office, and removed his hereditary rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had not asked to join the campaign, the emperor rebuked him in edict, stripped him of office, and removed his hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 閻相師，字渭陽，陝西高台人。

translations.literal: Yan Xiangshi, style Weiyang, was a native of Gaotai in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xiangshi, style Weiyang, was a native of Gaotai in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 入伍。

translations.literal: He enlisted.
translations.idiomatic: He enlisted.

sentences.zh: 累遷安西前營游擊。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to mobile-force commander of the front camp of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to mobile-force commander of the front camp of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 雅爾哈善謀誅厄魯特降人沙克都爾曼吉。

translations.literal: Ya Erhashan plotted to execute the surrendered Oirat Shakeduer Mangji.
translations.idiomatic: Ya Erhashan plotted to execute the surrendered Oirat Shakeduer Mangji.

sentences.zh: 天大雪，相師將五百人，偽為失道，求寄宿其壘。

translations.literal: Heavy snow fell; Xiangshi led five hundred men, feigning that they had lost their way, and sought lodging in their camp.
translations.idiomatic: In heavy snow Xiangshi led five hundred men, pretending they had lost their way, and asked to lodge in their camp.

sentences.zh: 夜分，鳴笳驟起，殺沙克都爾曼吉，殲其部眾四千餘人。

translations.literal: At midnight they sounded horns and suddenly rose, killed Shakeduer Mangji, and annihilated more than four thousand of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight they sounded horns and struck suddenly, killed Shakeduer Mangji, and wiped out more than four thousand of his followers.

sentences.zh: 尋偕副將醜達將千人赴魯克察克同額敏和卓逐回酋莽阿里克。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, together with vice general Chouda, he led a thousand men to Lukchak to join Emin Hezhuo in driving out the Muslim chief Mang'aliq.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, with vice general Chouda, he led a thousand men to Lukchak to join Emin Hezhuo in driving out the Muslim chief Mang'aliq.

sentences.zh: 錄功，遷金塔寺營副將。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded; he was transferred to be vice general of Jinta Temple Camp.
translations.idiomatic: His merit was recorded, and he was transferred to vice general of Jinta Temple Camp.

sentences.zh: 屯田吐魯番。

translations.literal: He conducted garrison farming at Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: He conducted garrison farming at Turfan.

sentences.zh: 擢甘肅肅州鎮總兵，賜花翎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to regional commander of Suzhou in Gansu and granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to regional commander of Suzhou in Gansu and granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 從雅爾哈善討霍集占，授領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He followed Ya Erhashan in campaigning against Huojizhan and was appointed column commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Ya Erhashan against Huojizhan and was appointed column commander.

sentences.zh: 圍庫車，力戰被創。

translations.literal: Besieging Kuche, he fought fiercely and was wounded.
translations.idiomatic: At the siege of Kuche he fought fiercely and was wounded.

sentences.zh: 師克阿克蘇，以相師駐守。

translations.literal: When the army captured Aksu, Xiangshi was stationed there to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: When the army took Aksu, Xiangshi was left to garrison the city.

sentences.zh: 已，复隨剿霍集占於葉爾羌。

translations.literal: Thereafter he again followed in suppressing Huojizhan at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined again in suppressing Huojizhan at Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 授安西提督，駐喀什噶爾。

translations.literal: He was appointed Military Governor of Anxi and garrisoned Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Military Governor of Anxi and garrisoned Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改甘肅提督，移駐庫車。

translations.literal: Before long he was changed to Military Governor of Gansu and moved his garrison to Kuche.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was reassigned as Military Governor of Gansu and moved his headquarters to Kuche.

sentences.zh: 上命屯田烏魯木齊。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered garrison farming at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered garrison farming at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，入覲，賚銀幣，圖形紫光閣。

translations.literal: On the triumphal return he was received in audience, rewarded with silver and coins, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: On his triumphal return he was received in audience, rewarded with silver and coins, and his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 引疾罷，予食全俸。

translations.literal: Citing illness he resigned; he was granted full salary.
translations.idiomatic: He resigned citing illness and was granted full salary.

sentences.zh: 旋卒，贈太子太保，諡桓肅。

translations.literal: He soon died; he was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous title Huansu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died and was posthumously granted Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous title Huansu.

sentences.zh: 相師軀幹修偉，有至性。

translations.literal: Xiangshi was tall and imposing in stature and possessed utmost filial devotion.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangshi was tall and imposing, with a deeply filial nature.

sentences.zh: 既貴，念親不逮養，每食泣下。

translations.literal: After he rose to eminence, thinking that he could no longer care for his parents in life, he wept at every meal.
translations.idiomatic: After he rose to eminence, remembering that he could no longer care for his parents in life, he wept at every meal.

sentences.zh: 得俸與兄弟，不問出入。

translations.literal: He gave his salary to his brothers without asking about income or expenditure.
translations.idiomatic: He gave his salary to his brothers without keeping track of what came in or went out.

sentences.zh: 所居鎮夷堡地萬畝，為濬渠灌溉，數百家利賴之。

translations.literal: At Zhenyi Fort where he lived, ten thousand mu of land were irrigated by canals he dredged, to the benefit of several hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhenyi Fort, where he lived, he dredged canals to irrigate ten thousand mu of land, to the lasting benefit of several hundred households.

sentences.zh: 伊柱，薩克達氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Yizhu, of the Sakda clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu, of the Sakda clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父塔勒馬善，雍正間，以副都統將歸化城兵從征噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: His father Tale'mashan, in the Yongzheng reign, as vice commandant led Guihuacheng troops in campaigning against Galdan Tsewang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tale'mashan, in the Yongzheng reign, led Guihuacheng troops as vice commandant against Galdan Tsewang.

sentences.zh: 將軍達爾濟駐伯格爾，世宗命塔勒馬善參贊軍務。

translations.literal: General Da'erji was garrisoned at Bo'erge; the Shizong ordered Tale'mashan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: General Da'erji was garrisoned at Bo'erge, and the Shizong ordered Tale'mashan to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 署前鋒統領，逐賊至額得爾河源，駐軍烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: Acting as vanguard commander, he pursued bandits to the source of the Eder River and garrisoned Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: As acting vanguard commander he pursued bandits to the source of the Eder River and garrisoned Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，權定邊左副將軍，召還。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong he acted as Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General and was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he served as acting Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General and was recalled.

sentences.zh: 師复徵準噶爾，命赴額爾齊斯屯田。

translations.literal: When the army again campaigned against the Dzungars, he was ordered to go to the Irtysh for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: When the army campaigned against the Dzungars again, he was ordered to the Irtysh for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，授北路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Northern Route campaign counselor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was appointed Northern Route campaign counselor.

sentences.zh: 復召還，授護軍統領。

translations.literal: He was again recalled and appointed commander of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled again and appointed commander of the guards.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 伊柱，自佐領再遷索倫總管。

translations.literal: Yizhu, from assistant banner commander was again promoted to Solon commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu rose from assistant banner commander to Solon commander.

sentences.zh: 偕副都統濟福、侍衛德爾森保赴喀爾喀車臣部捕盜，得逋賊。

translations.literal: Together with Vice Commandant Jifu and bodyguard De'ersenbao he went to the Khalkha Chakhar department to capture bandits and obtained fugitive bandits.
translations.idiomatic: With Vice Commandant Jifu and bodyguard De'ersenbao he went to the Khalkha Chakhar department to capture bandits and took several fugitives.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，從將軍兆惠討霍集占。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed General Zhao Hui in campaigning against Huojizhan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he followed General Zhao Hui against Huojizhan.

sentences.zh: 霍集占之棄葉爾羌走也，副將軍富德等逐之，至阿爾楚爾。

translations.literal: When Huojizhan abandoned Yarkand and fled, Vice General Fu De and others pursued him to Altur.
translations.idiomatic: When Huojizhan abandoned Yarkand and fled, Vice General Fu De and others pursued him as far as Altur.

sentences.zh: 賊設伏兩山間，師分三隊奮擊，伊柱領右翼，戰自辰至午，賊大潰。

translations.literal: The bandits set an ambush between two mountains; the army divided into three columns and struck fiercely; Yizhu led the right wing; fighting from the chen hour to the wu hour, the bandits were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels laid an ambush between two mountains; the army struck in three columns; Yizhu led the right wing; from morning until noon the rebels were utterly routed.

sentences.zh: 翌日，至巴達克山界伊西洱庫爾淖爾，賊據險守。

translations.literal: The next day they reached the Badakhshan border at Lake Yixihuku'er; the bandits held the terrain and defended.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they reached the Badakhshan border at Lake Yixihuku'er, where the rebels held the difficult ground and defended.

sentences.zh: 師分道進攻，樹白纛，降賊萬餘。

translations.literal: The army attacked from several routes, raised white standards, and more than ten thousand bandits submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The army attacked from several directions, raised white standards, and more than ten thousand rebels surrendered.

sentences.zh: 伊柱偕巴圖濟爾噶勒等堵山後策應。

translations.literal: Yizhu, together with Batujiergale and others, blocked the rear of the mountains in support.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu, with Batujiergale and others, blocked the mountain rear in support.

sentences.zh: 富德遣侍衛賽音圖等諭巴達克山汗，使擒霍集占以獻。

translations.literal: Fu De dispatched bodyguard Saiyintu and others to instruct the Badakhshan khan to seize Huojizhan and deliver him.
translations.idiomatic: Fu De sent bodyguard Saiyintu and others to tell the khan of Badakhshan to seize Huojizhan and hand him over.

sentences.zh: 伊柱駐兵卡倫為聲援。

translations.literal: Yizhu garrisoned troops at the pass as reinforcement.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu garrisoned troops at the pass to lend support.

sentences.zh: 瓦罕伯克率所部降。

translations.literal: The beg of Wakhan led his following to submit.
translations.idiomatic: The beg of Wakhan led his following in submission.

sentences.zh: 尋，巴達克山汗素勒坦沙函獻霍集占首。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the Badakhshan khan Sultan Shah sent Huojizhan's head in a letter.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the khan of Badakhshan, Sultan Shah, sent Huojizhan's head in a dispatch.

sentences.zh: 回部平。

translations.literal: The Muslim districts were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The Muslim districts were pacified.

sentences.zh: 伊柱將千人駐喀什噶爾，護諸降人屯田伊犁。

translations.literal: Yizhu led a thousand men to garrison Kashgar and protect the various surrendered peoples in garrison farming at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu led a thousand men to garrison Kashgar and protect the surrendered peoples farming at Ili.

sentences.zh: 師還，上御豐澤園宴勞，賜伊柱緞十二、白金五百。

translations.literal: When the army returned, the emperor feasted them at Fengze Garden; Yizhu was granted twelve bolts of silk and five hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, the emperor feasted the troops at Fengze Garden and granted Yizhu twelve bolts of silk and five hundred taels of white silver.

sentences.zh: 伊柱復出領屯田，為置台守望，疏渠灌溉，農隙督佃伐木作屋以居，上諭令加意開拓。

translations.literal: Yizhu again went out to lead garrison farming, established courier stations for guard and watch, dredged canals for irrigation, and in farming intervals supervised tenants in felling timber to build houses for dwelling; the emperor instructed him to devote himself to development.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhu went out again to lead garrison farming, set up courier stations for guard duty, dredged irrigation canals, and in farming intervals had tenants cut timber and build houses; the emperor instructed him to press on with development.

sentences.zh: 遷鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，擊賊老官屯。

translations.literal: He followed General Mingrui in the Burma campaign and attacked bandits at Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: He followed General Mingrui against Burma and attacked rebels at Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 卒於軍，進三等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: He died in the army and was advanced to a hereditary third-class Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: He died on campaign and was advanced to a hereditary third-class Commandant of Light Chariots.

sentences.zh: 努三，瓜爾佳氏，吉林滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Nusan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Jilin Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Jilin Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒再遷頭等侍衛、御前行走。

translations.literal: From vanguard he was again promoted to first-class bodyguard and served in the imperial presence.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard to first-class bodyguard and served in the imperial presence.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十一年，四川總督慶復剿下瞻對頭人班滾，命努三如慶復軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Qianlong, Sichuan governor-general Qingfu campaigned against the lower Zang chief Banbo; Nusan was ordered to join Qingfu's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of the Qianlong reign, Sichuan governor-general Qingfu campaigned against the lower Zang chief Banbo, and Nusan was ordered to join Qingfu's army.

sentences.zh: 慶復疏報班滾焚死，罷兵。

translations.literal: Qingfu memorialized that Banbo had burned himself to death and the troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Qingfu reported that Banbo had burned himself to death, and the troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 張廣泗代慶復，言班滾現在。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangsi replaced Qingfu and reported that Banbo was still alive.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangsi replaced Qingfu and reported that Banbo was still alive.

sentences.zh: 慶復坐得罪，努三罷御前行走。

translations.literal: Qingfu was found guilty; Nusan was dismissed from service in the imperial presence.
translations.idiomatic: Qingfu was punished; Nusan was dismissed from service in the imperial presence.

sentences.zh: 尋授鑲白旗蒙古副都統、正藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner and commander of the guards of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered White Banner and commander of the guards of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，師徵準噶爾，命從湖廣總督永常籌軍事。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was ordered to join Huguang governor-general Yongchang in preparing military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was ordered to assist Huguang governor-general Yongchang in military preparations.

sentences.zh: 旋帥師駐鄂爾坤。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he led troops to garrison the Orkhon.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led troops to garrison the Orkhon.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾宰桑瑪木特闌入卡倫。

translations.literal: The Dzungar zaisang Mamut broke through the pass.
translations.idiomatic: The Dzungar zaisang Mamut broke through the border pass.

sentences.zh: 授參贊大臣，命會將軍成袞札布逐捕。

translations.literal: He was appointed campaign counselor and ordered to join General Chenggunjab in pursuit and capture.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed campaign counselor and ordered to join General Chenggunjab in pursuit and capture.

sentences.zh: 努三與參贊大臣薩賴爾、護軍統領烏勒登合軍，軍不戢，雜取牲畜。

translations.literal: Nusan joined campaign counselor Salai'er and guards commander Wuleideng in combining armies; the troops were undisciplined and indiscriminately took livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan joined campaign counselor Salai'er and guards commander Wuleideng; their combined troops were undisciplined and seized livestock indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 努三獲逃人特赫拜哈都，未聞上。

translations.literal: Nusan captured the fugitive Tekebai Hadu but did not report it to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan captured the fugitive Tekebai Hadu but did not report it to the emperor.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登收烏梁海，縱逃人巴朗。

translations.literal: Wuleideng received the Urianghai but released the fugitive Balang.
translations.idiomatic: Wuleideng took in the Urianghai but released the fugitive Balang.

sentences.zh: 上詰責努三、烏勒登，下定北將軍班第等按治。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Nusan and Wuleideng and ordered Pacification of the North General Bandi and others to investigate and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rebuked Nusan and Wuleideng and ordered Pacification of the North General Bandi and others to investigate and punish them.

sentences.zh: 努三、烏勒登自陳收牲畜匿以自私事始薩賴爾，上以薩賴爾新降，不知法度，責努三等不得以此諉過。

translations.literal: Nusan and Wuleideng themselves stated that the matter of seizing livestock and concealing them for private gain had begun with Salai'er; the emperor held that Salai'er had only recently submitted and did not know the law, and rebuked Nusan and the others for not being allowed to shift blame onto him.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan and Wuleideng admitted that the seizure and concealment of livestock for private gain had begun with Salai'er; the emperor held that Salai'er had only recently submitted and did not know the regulations, and rebuked Nusan and the others for trying to shift the blame onto him.

sentences.zh: 尋讞上，坐失巴朗，罪當斬。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter the judgment was submitted; for losing Balang the offense warranted execution.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was submitted, losing Balang was judged a capital offense.

sentences.zh: 詔錄其前勞，恕死，留軍，仍籍其家。

translations.literal: An edict recorded their former merit, pardoned death, kept them with the army, but still registered their households for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict took account of their earlier merit, spared their lives, kept them with the army, but still registered their households for punishment.

sentences.zh: 旋授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed Blue Plume Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 再遷頭等侍衛，命與左都御史何國宗赴伊犁，測天度，繪地圖。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to first-class bodyguard and ordered, together with Left Censor-in-Chief He Guozong, to go to Ili to measure celestial degrees and draw maps.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to first-class bodyguard and ordered, with Left Censor-in-Chief He Guozong, to go to Ili to measure celestial degrees and draw maps.

sentences.zh: 送兵詣巴里坤，請回京。

translations.literal: He escorted troops to Barkol and requested to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After escorting troops to Barkol, he asked to return to the capital.

sentences.zh: 左授藍翎侍衛，留巴里坤差遣。

translations.literal: He was demoted to Blue Plume Bodyguard and left at Barkol on assignment.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Blue Plume Bodyguard and left at Barkol on assignment.

sentences.zh: 招撫巴爾達穆特各鄂拓克有勞，三遷鑲藍旗護軍統領，督巴里坤屯田。

translations.literal: For merit in inducing and comforting the various otoks of the Bardanmut, he was promoted three ranks to commander of the guards of the Bordered Blue Banner and supervised garrison farming at Barkol.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in pacifying the various otoks of the Bardanmut, he was promoted three ranks to commander of the guards of the Bordered Blue Banner and supervised garrison farming at Barkol.

sentences.zh: 兆惠被圍黑水，努三從定邊左副將軍富德往援，至呼爾璊，分兩翼擊賊，與兆惠軍會，賜騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Zhao Hui was besieged at Black Water, Nusan followed Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Fu De to the relief; reaching Hu'erlan, they divided into two wings to attack the bandits, joined Zhao Hui's army, and he was granted a hereditary Cavalry Captaincy.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hui was besieged at Black Water, Nusan followed Pacification of the Frontier Left Vice General Fu De to his relief; at Hu'erlan they struck the rebels in two wings, united with Zhao Hui's army, and Nusan was granted a hereditary Cavalry Captaincy.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜銀幣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was rewarded with silver and coins.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he was rewarded with silver and coins.

sentences.zh: 累遷領侍衛內大臣、正藍旗滿洲都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard and Manchu commander of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to Grand Minister of the Imperial Guard and Manchu commander of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡恪靖。

translations.literal: He died; he was given the posthumous title Kejing.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was given the posthumous title Kejing.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登，烏禮蘇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Wuleideng, of the Ulisu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wuleideng, of the Ulisu clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒累遷鑲黃旗蒙古副都統、護軍統​​領。

translations.literal: From vanguard he was promoted in succession to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard to Mongol vice commandant of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the guards.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十三年，從征金川。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong, he accompanied the campaign against Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Qianlong reign he took part in the campaign against Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆至軍，令駐軍馬奈。

translations.literal: When Grand Secretary and Pacification Commissioner Fu Heng reached the army, he ordered troops garrisoned at Manai.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretary and Pacification Commissioner Fu Heng reached the army, he ordered troops garrisoned at Manai.

sentences.zh: 十八年，師徵準噶爾，授參贊大臣，駐烏里雅蘇台。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was appointed campaign counselor and garrisoned at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, when the army campaigned against the Dzungars, he was appointed campaign counselor and garrisoned at Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 扎哈沁宰桑瑪木特等闌入卡倫，烏勒登偕喀爾喀副都統策登扎卜將五百人，與參贊大臣努三分道捕治。

translations.literal: The Zahachin zaisang Mamut and others broke through the pass; Wuleideng, together with Khalkha Vice Commandant Tserengjab, led five hundred men and, with campaign counselor Nusan, pursued and punished them by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zahachin zaisang Mamut and others broke through the pass, Wuleideng and Khalkha Vice Commandant Tserengjab led five hundred men and, with campaign counselor Nusan, pursued them by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 參贊大臣薩賴爾收烏梁海，烏勒登自索郭克策應，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Campaign counselor Salai'er received the Urianghai; Wuleideng supported him from Suogoke and captured a great many.
translations.idiomatic: When campaign counselor Salai'er took in the Urianghai, Wuleideng supported him from Suogoke and captured a great many.

sentences.zh: 尋坐縱逃人巴朗，並與努三匿所獲烏梁海牲畜，罪當斬，貸死從軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, for releasing the fugitive Balang and, together with Nusan, concealing Urianghai livestock they had obtained, the offense warranted execution; death was commuted and he remained with the army.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, for releasing the fugitive Balang and, with Nusan, concealing Urianghai livestock they had seized, he was sentenced to death; the sentence was commuted and he remained with the army.

sentences.zh: 尋授頭等侍衛，命選厄魯特宰桑厄勒錐音等兵赴伊犁討賊。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was appointed first-class bodyguard and ordered to select Oirat zaisang Elechuin and other troops to go to Ili to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed first-class bodyguard and ordered to select Oirat zaisang Elechuin and other troops for the campaign against bandits at Ili.

sentences.zh: 加副都統銜，授領隊大臣，進剿阿巴噶斯、哈丹等游牧。

translations.literal: He was given the rank of vice commandant, appointed column commander, and advanced to suppress the pastures of Abagasi, Hadan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the rank of vice commandant, appointed column commander, and advanced against the pastures of Abagasi, Hadan, and others.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納竄哈薩克，定西將軍策楞遣烏勒登將千人從參贊大臣玉保逐捕，玉保中道引還。

translations.literal: Amursana fled into Kazakh territory; Pacification of the West General Celeng dispatched Wuleideng to lead a thousand men with campaign counselor Yubao in pursuit; Yubao turned back midway.
translations.idiomatic: When Amursana fled into Kazakh lands, Pacification of the West General Celeng sent Wuleideng with a thousand men to join campaign counselor Yubao in pursuit; Yubao turned back halfway.

sentences.zh: 烏勒登師至庫隴癸嶺，阿睦爾撒納脫走。

translations.literal: When Wuleideng's army reached Kulungui Ridge, Amursana escaped.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuleideng's army reached Kulungui Ridge, Amursana got away.

sentences.zh: 逮詣京師，廷鞫，言：「初聞阿睦爾撒納遁，請發兵速追之。

translations.literal: He was brought to the capital and tried at court, where he said: "When I first heard that Amursana had fled, I requested troops be sent at once in rapid pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Brought to the capital and tried at court, he said: "When I first heard that Amursana had fled, I asked that troops be sent at once in rapid pursuit.

sentences.zh: 策楞、玉保俱不允。

translations.literal: Celeng and Yubao both refused.
translations.idiomatic: Celeng and Yubao both refused.

sentences.zh: 後從玉保往，復請追擊。

translations.literal: Later, when I followed Yubao, I again requested pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when I followed Yubao, I again asked to pursue.

sentences.zh: 玉保止發兵五十，至庫隴癸嶺，僅餘二十人，駝复乏。

translations.literal: Yubao sent only fifty troops; when we reached Kulungui Ridge, only twenty men remained, and camels were again scarce.
translations.idiomatic: Yubao sent only fifty men; by the time we reached Kulungui Ridge only twenty remained, and camels were again in short supply.

sentences.zh: 阿睦爾撒納於師行日已過嶺竄哈薩克。

translations.literal: Amursana had already crossed the ridge and fled into Kazakh territory on the day our army marched."
translations.idiomatic: Amursana had already crossed the ridge and fled into Kazakh territory on the day our army marched."

sentences.zh: 」上以其言實，貸死，授三等侍衛，在乾清門行走。

translations.literal: The emperor held his account to be true, commuted death, appointed him third-class bodyguard, and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor found his account truthful, commuted the death sentence, appointed him third-class bodyguard, and ordered him to serve at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 尋仍遣赴軍。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was again sent to the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent back to the army.

sentences.zh: 定邊將軍兆惠招降布勒特部頭目圖魯啟拜，令烏勒登自珠木罕至圖固斯塔老宣詔，護降人入覲。

translations.literal: Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui induced the Burut leader Turuqibai to submit; he ordered Wuleideng from Zhumuhan to Tugustalao to proclaim the edict and escort the surrendered people to audience.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification of the Frontier General Zhao Hui induced the Burut leader Turuqibai to submit and ordered Wuleideng from Zhumuhan to Tugustalao to proclaim the edict and escort the surrendered people to audience.

sentences.zh: 擢頭等侍衛，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: He was promoted to first-class bodyguard and appointed campaign counselor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to first-class bodyguard and appointed campaign counselor.

sentences.zh: 令捕瑪哈沁，並截霍集占逃路。

translations.literal: He was ordered to capture Mahaqin and also cut off Huojizhan's escape route.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to capture Mahaqin and cut off Huojizhan's escape route.

sentences.zh: 尋以捕瑪哈沁不力，令在領隊大臣上行走。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter, for ineffective pursuit of Mahaqin, he was ordered to serve above the column commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, for failing to capture Mahaqin effectively, he was ordered to serve in a supervisory capacity over the column commanders.

sentences.zh: 師還，累遷鑲黃旗蒙古都統、左翼前鋒統領。

translations.literal: When the army returned, he was promoted in succession to Mongol commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, he rose to Mongol commander of the Bordered Yellow Banner and commander of the Left Vanguard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：從兆惠、富德討霍集占有功諸將校，若瑚爾起、愛隆阿殲敵搴旗，見於詠歌，厥績懋焉。

translations.literal: The historian remarks: Among the officers who followed Zhao Hui and Fu De in campaigning against Huojizhan and won merit, such as Hu Erqi and Ai Long'a, who destroyed the enemy and seized standards—celebrated in song—their achievements were truly great.
translations.idiomatic: The historian remarks: Among the officers who followed Zhao Hui and Fu De against Huojizhan and distinguished themselves—men such as Hu Erqi and Ai Long'a, who destroyed the enemy and seized standards, celebrated in song—their achievements were truly great.

sentences.zh: 舒明逐叛拊降，以勞受爵。

translations.literal: Shu Ming pursued rebels and comforted those who submitted, and received a noble rank for his labors.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Ming pursued rebels and comforted those who surrendered, and was ennobled for his labors.

sentences.zh: 福祿、努三與呼爾璊之役，齊里克齊佐色勒庫爾之戰，相師助庫車之圍，伊柱收伊西洱之降，錄功皆居最，抑亦其次也。

translations.literal: Fu Lu and Nusan at the battle of Hu'erlan, Qilikeqi assisting at the battle of Sarikul, Xiangshi aiding the siege of Kuche, Yizhu receiving the submission at Yixihuer—in recording merit they all ranked foremost, yet they were still second in rank.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Lu and Nusan at Hu'erlan, Qilikeqi at Sarikul, Xiangshi at the siege of Kuche, Yizhu at the surrender at Yixihuer—in the recording of merit they all ranked at the top, yet they were still second to those named above.
